title.en: Green light, red light: a collision

subtitle.zh-TW: 兩輛車都沒剎車才撞上，為什麼只說闖紅燈的那輛是原因？
subtitle.en: Neither car braked and they collided; why is only the red-light runner picked out as the cause?

story.zh-TW: 考慮一個十字路口：甲在綠燈亮起時，依速限直接通過，沒有剎車。另一個方向的乙闖紅燈，同樣沒有剎車，兩輛車因此相撞。甲若剎車，或乙若剎車，兩車都不會相撞。
story.en: Consider a crossroads. Driver A passes through on a green light at the speed limit without braking. Driver B, coming from the other direction, runs the red light, also without braking, and the two cars collide. Had A braked, or had B braked, they would not have collided.

zh-TW.sentence: 甲在綠燈亮起時，依速限直接通過，沒有剎車。
另一個方向的乙闖紅燈，同樣沒有剎車，兩輛車因此相撞。

en.sentence: Driver A passes through on a green light at the speed limit without braking.
Driver B, coming from the other direction, runs the red light, also without braking, and the two cars collide.

text.zh-TW: 直覺和實務上，都以闖紅燈的乙沒剎車為車禍的主要原因，守規矩的甲不是。
text.en: By intuition and in practice, the red-light runner's not braking is the main cause of the crash, and the law-abiding driver's not braking is not.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型依故事擬成：兩車都沒剎車才會相撞（CR = ¬BA·¬BB）。簡單反事實依賴與 HP 定義都把兩人沒剎車判為原因，因為任一方剎車就不會撞。交通規則使兩人不同：綠燈直行的甲不需要剎車（預設 BA = 0），闖紅燈的乙本來應該停下（預設 BB = 1）。甲剎車的見證世界比實際世界更偏離預設，乙剎車的見證世界則不偏離，所以引擎只把乙判為原因，與王鵬翔 (2019) 的說法一致。
explanation.en: The model is built from the story: the cars collide only if neither brakes (CR = ¬BA·¬BB). The simple counterfactual test and the HP definitions count both drivers' not braking as causes, since a collision is avoided if either brakes. The traffic rules make the two differ: A, going straight on a green light, need not brake (default BA = 0), while B, facing a red light, should have stopped (default BB = 1). The witness world in which A brakes is more deviant than the actual world, and the one in which B brakes is not, so the engine makes only B a cause, in agreement with Wang (2019).

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H. (2019). The problems of counterfactual thinking in omissive causal judgements [in Chinese]. EurAmerica, 49(3), 287–340.
Wang, P.-H., & Wang, L. (2026). Causal dialectics [in Chinese]. National Taiwan University Press.

note.zh-TW: 第 1 章例 1 是只有闖紅燈一方的版本（甲闖紅燈撞傷行人乙）。
note.en: Example 1 of chapter 1 is a one-party version (a red-light runner injures a pedestrian).

verdicts.note: Witness: BA = 1 departs from what a driver with the green light does.
